claim: Multiplex networks have been successfully applied to epidemiology.

evidence: Supported by citations to Lima et al., 2015; De Domenico et al., 2016; Sanz et al., 2014

claim: Multiplex networks have been successfully applied to ecology.

evidence: Supported by citations to Sonia Kéfi et al., 2015; Kéfi et al., 2016; Pilosof et al., 2017; Stella et al., 2016

claim: Multiplex networks are multi-layer networks in which multi-relational interactions give rise to a collection of network layers so that the same node can engage in different interactions with different neighbours in each layer.

evidence: Supported by citations to Kivela et al., 2014; Boccaletti et al., 2014; De Domenico et al., 2013

claim: The ecomultiplex framework allows to account for multiple types of interactions giving rise to parasite transmission with similar or different time scales.
